carriedObservations.D3APLAN-R4-NBO-1: Accepted and carried to D3a-1: after a killed lane, a direct invocation may read the left-over path file and pass while the fixture bytes are unchanged; the next lane deletes it. D3a-1 states exactly that and claims nothing stronger.

rootAssessment: Lead assent to the D3a plan r4 (M3-D r5 items 12-17 and 20-22): the supervisor in four sub-units, D3a-0 (platform try_reap and abandon/Unreaped, the bounded scratch walks) to D3a-3; the participant owning incremental acquisition through D2b-1's FrameAccumulator and a pending-write buffer under a one-call yield contract; the normal-end path; the single-owner settlement; scratch walks on the discovery profile's sourced caps with a cross-law item; every S-OP-2 item 23 field resolved or an explicit blocker; the harness-free fixture bound lane-scoped by path and digest; tool materialization accounting allocated to D3; and the narrow LD-D3A-17 amendment for a work-exhausted scratch retention with no errno (errno K2 for io-failure). Rounds 1 to 3 left seven, one and one findings, each answered in the next round.
